title: Algiven Fantasy Modpack
description: A Minecraft fantasy modpack by Algiven
body:
##  *_Algiven Minecraft fantasy modpack_*
VERSION: 1.2

Transforms your Minecraft world into a rich fantasy RPG experience while still maintaining the **core vanilla experience**.

The experience focuses on adventure, progression, and immersion.

 - Change singleplayer world generation to make it more big
 - Added more animation for mob and player
 - Added more mob variant
 - Added more interactive particle and effect
 - added more interactive ambient, sound and soundtrack
